DeployBot: signal: embeddings route p95 +22% after v4.2.2 rollout to mixed pools. auto-revert score=0.65 :warning:
Maya T: saw it. which pools/regions?
DeployBot: affected: dedicated-pool-12 (US), dedicated-pool-15 (APAC, low traffic). Hosted unaffected. quality metric: recall dip on internal suite.
Owen G: auto-revert score borderline. I'd prefer staged fix: reduce routing to new model in pool-12, pin pool-15 back to v4.2.1, and hold hosted. This minimizes churn.
Nora S: agree. Sales/CS must be notified for pool-12 because two paying tenants there. CS-Bot, prep a short notice and provide opt-in touchpoint.
CS-Bot: draft ready: "We detected a small regression in embedding recall for a subset of dedicated customers. We're taking immediate action to revert the model for affected environments and will follow up with details and timeline." Approve?
Maya T: approve. Operational plan: 1) annotate release to suppress auto-revert, 2) set route policy for pool-12 to redirect 80% traffic to v4.2.1, 3) pin pool-15 to v4.2.1, 4) run canary smoke on pool-12, 5) finalize rollback if smoke fails. Who owns steps?
Owen G: I'll do annotations + routing change for pool-12. Maya, can you handle pin+rollback for pool-15? Nora will coordinate CS outbound.
DeployBot: suggested commands:
```
redwood deploy annotate --release=v4.2.2 --key=auto_revert --value=suppressed_by_ops
redwood traffic set-policy --route=embeddings --targets=dedicated-pool-12 --policy=split --weights=20:80 --versions=v4.2.2,v4.2.1
redwood release pin v4.2.1 --targets=dedicated-pool-15
redwood deploy rollback --to v4.2.1 --scope=dedicated-pool-15
```
OncallBot: change window: open until 03:00 UTC. If routing change persists >30m, escalate to oncall for window extension.
Owen G: annotating release now, then applying traffic split to pool-12.
Owen G: annotation success. applying traffic split...
Owen G: traffic split applied (80% -> v4.2.1). Monitoring canary metrics.
Maya T: pin for pool-15 in progress.
Maya T: pin success, initiating rollback for pool-15.
Maya T: rollback complete for pool-15. smoke: recall restored to within 0.7% on pool-15 canary.
Nora S: sending customer notes now to two tenants in pool-12. CS will offer a short engineering sync if they want.
Owen G: canary on pool-12 (20% traffic to v4.2.2) looking at metrics: recall slightly improved but still 1.8% off baseline; won't accept yet. Decision: escalate to full rollback of pool-12 if delta >1.5% after a 10m observation.
Maya T: agreed. I'll be ready to pin+rollback pool-12.
DeployBot: log: release annotated, staged traffic split executed, pool-15 rolled back manually by Maya T. auto-revert suppressed.
OncallBot: note: window OK for now. Ops will extend if rollback runs long.
Nora S: customers acknowledged and appreciated the proactive message.
Owen G: after 10m observe, pool-12 delta still 1.6% -> executing pin+rollback now.
Owen G: pin v4.2.1 succeeded. starting rollback...
Owen G: rollback complete. smoke: recall within 0.9% baseline on pool-12.
Maya T: opening postmortem PM-4560 and assigning to eng-ml + infra. include timeline, traffic-split config, and CS messages.
CS-Bot: updated customer follow-up template and added a link to the PM.
Owen G: closing this thread. thanks team for fast coordination. :clap:
